title: Quarterly bridgework: hosted API + model catalog commitment scenarios
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: produce a compact, executable quarterly plan that connects OKRs to a prioritized set of hosted API features and model-catalog actions. Scope spans: (1) hosted API endpoint lifecycle (new endpoints, deprecations, performance budgets), (2) model catalog lineup and staged rotations, (3) canary/capacity windows for Dedicated, and (4) operational readiness (console dashboards + eval gating). Deliverables: prioritized initiative list, commitment lanes (gold/silver/bronze), canary calendar, acceptance criteria and evaluation suites per model, rollout playbook, post-release metrics and regression triggers. Success metrics mapped to OKRs: O1 - Reduce 95th pct latency for text generation by 15% (KR1: runtime perf work items committed); O2 - Decrease hosted per-token cost by 10% for high-throughput endpoints (KR2: batching and cache configs rolled out); O3 - Increase catalog coverage for regulated customers with 2 VPC-certified models (KR3: private onboarding path defined). This ticket captures cross-functional dependencies and the scenario matrix for three demand curves (baseline, surge, conservative).
acceptance_criteria: Prioritized initiative list with clear owner and estimate for each item
Canary calendar that covers hosted endpoints and model swaps with rollback thresholds
Evaluation suite links for each model with baseline scorecards and regression alerts
Cost/latency tradeoff table mapping batching/quantization knobs to expected unit economics
Operations checklist for Dedicated capacity and Private deployment (runbooks + dashboards)
